description: This file defines the UserEntity class which implements the UserEntityInterface for OAuth2 functionality within the Api\V8\OAuth2\Entity namespace. It encapsulates user identification data, specifically a user ID, for OAuth2 token management.

classes.name: UserEntity
classes.description: Implements the UserEntityInterface, representing a user in the OAuth2 server, mainly providing user ID retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the user entity with a user ID.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with this user entity.
